sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [DATATYPE_QUANTITY_ACCESS] MainShape / nltl:iceTypeClassification property shape: The classification value is constrained only to be an IRI, but the canonical property range is nltl:iceTypeValue. Arbitrary IRIs can therefore be supplied as ice type classifications and pass the property constraint when they are not the thinFirstYearIce controlled value. Required change: Add a node class constraint requiring each nltl:iceTypeClassification value to be an instance of nltl:iceTypeValue, while retaining the existing single-value and conditional-thickness checks.
